bureau: Credit reference bureaus licensed under the Credit Reference Bureau Act (Registrar of Financial Institutions)
note: The Credit Reference Bureau Act (Cap. 46:09; 18 of 2010 as amended by 6 of 2016), MalawiLII's consolidated text at 31 December 2017 (Fifth Revised Edition, L.R.O. 1/2018), read from archive.org's snapshot of 10 December 2025 (malawilii.org's source document answers with a Cloudflare check); the archive's captures of the Act on MalawiLII list no later version than the 2017 consolidation. Section 21: a credit reference bureau shall maintain a historical database covering a seven-year period for providing detailed credit information: written as keep 7, the period of history a bureau's detailed credit information covers (the Act sets no other period and no deletion rule; this is the game's reading of 'covering a seven year period'). Section 13B (inserted by 6 of 2016): a financial institution updates the credit information it furnishes to the bureaus on a monthly basis, or earlier where an update is necessary, with no threshold: written as reported 30 days after the due date (a monthly cycle). Section 2: the Registrar is the Registrar of Financial Institutions under the Financial Services Act.

sources.said: 21. Retention of data A credit reference bureau shall maintain a historical database covering a seven year period for the purpose of providing detailed credit information ...  A financial institution shall, on a monthly basis, or within such earlier time as an update is necessary, ensure that the credit information furnished to credit reference bureaux is consistently updated ... ” means the Registrar of Financial Institutions appointed under the Financial Services Act;
